meta.title: Deleting a persisted stage queues it for server-side cleanup
gaps: The existing draft is not identified by title or project ID; execution requires it to be supplied as the executor's current event.
The deleted stage and surviving stage are unspecified, so the plan cannot assert the exact stage tabs before deletion and after reopening.
The setup does not establish that a second stage exists; Delete is disabled when only one stage remains.

The persisted stage's backend ID and draft-save request path are not supplied. expect_request can inspect a known request body, but cannot dynamically extract the stage ID and compare it with delete_draft_stage_uuids.

plan.title: Persisted stage deletion survives draft reload

steps.note: Reopen the supplied existing draft rather than creating a replacement event.
Open the first persisted stage's overflow menu.
Require a deletable stage; this fails if the draft has only one stage.
Delete the stage whose menu is open.
Check for a visible save error, without claiming that cleanup was verified.
Reopen the same draft to expose the persisted stage composition.
Record the reopened stage tabs for inspection; this is evidence, not an assertion that the deleted stage stayed absent.
